title: 『2024-2025 年末年始台湾 ８日間⑧　～５日目午前：台北観光　故宮博物院訪問と絶品魯肉飯と豚足を食す～』台北(台湾)の旅行記・ブログ by たびっこさんciteフォートラベル
description:
National Palace Museum Entrance

A family trip to Taipei’s National Palace Museum begins with a quiet morning arrival at the grand marble staircases leading up to the main hall. Taiwanese flags line the white balustrades, and the museum’s green-tiled roofs and pale yellow walls stand out against a backdrop of wooded hills under a cloudy sky. Only a handful of visitors are present before opening, allowing for unobstructed photos of the iconic facade.

Inside, the group uses their Taipei FunPASS to bypass the regular ticket line and store their luggage in self-service lockers. They explore renowned exhibits such as the Jadeite Cabbage and Mao Gong Ding, noting that some treasures like the Meat-Shaped Stone are on loan elsewhere. After a thorough tour of the first-floor galleries, they plan to continue their cultural and culinary adventure in Taipei, sampling local specialties and visiting other landmarks throughout the day.
